final: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, CAST(SUM(derived_product_cost) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), av AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.ratio / NULLIF(av.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN av WHERE av.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (inv.ratio / NULLIF(av.avg_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
